# V99 Censor level-one review

**Reviewer:** ENGINE. **Verdict:** pass at `47e3aa9`, 2026-09-21 (Chords 1396).
This record transcribes the independent review; WIZARD.2 did not self-attest.

The reviewer checked the wizard specification, pinned Compendium Censor Basics/advancement,
all level-one Censor feature and ability files, and printed deity/saint portfolios against the
slice. Twelve domains, three order skills, thirty-eight named portfolios, all characteristic
arrays and ordinary-kit eligibility match. The seventeen source abilities and twenty-five
embedded actions retain their source costs, timing and declared manual boundaries. Ledger
damage tables and strict Presence-derived potency thresholds match the source.

- R1 closed: Hands of the Maker and Faithful Friend use their invoking Censor as Self target;
  persisted readback observes that target. Grave Speech uses a zero-Stamina target.
- R2 closed: independent ledger values assert four paid Judgment options at 1 Wrath, Cleanse
  at 1 and Arrest Redirect at 3, including metadata, resource debit and unaffordable reuse.
- The Convex serialization repair retains printed Unicode deity names as values under ASCII
  source-path keys. Shared lookup covers evaluator pools, pruning and UI, retaining legacy keys.

Judgment state/timing, spatial effects, Wrath generation, Recovery transfer/healing, fate points,
companions and respite/equipment effects remain explicitly manual. No unimplemented automation
is claimed. No reviewer tests were run; TESTER owns runtime acceptance.

Authentic trailer: `Reviewed-By: ENGINE (pass, 2026-09-21)`.

Bounded follow-up **pass at `56ddceb`** (ENGINE, Chords 1403): Back Blasphemer! has Melee and
Weapon, so the pinned Kits Damage Bonuses rule applies Cloak and Dagger's +1/+1/+1 even without
Strike, giving 3/5/7. The original ledger and review missed this bonus; the live run exposed it.
The corrected expectations and filename/line-only diagnostic change pass; runtime is unchanged.
